verdict.rationale: The documented capture method is a bot: users invite fred@fireflies.ai to the meeting or let it auto-join calendar meetings, which is the visible participant this story wants to avoid. Nothing in the evidence shows bot-free capture of device audio. The uploadAudio API only transcribes existing files after the fact, a user-side workaround rather than live capture, and the dictation feature is voice-to-text, not meeting capture.

support.subject: As a founder, I can capture and transcribe meetings without a visible bot joining the call — audio is captured from my device so external participants see nothing extra
